decisions.reason: As a small extension of the established wooden gift range that also fits the firm's move toward adding technology, it still has option value despite somewhat higher complexity and carrying costs from its electronic feature.

This nativity stable sits squarely within the firm's traditional Christmas craft business, so in a growing market and broad assortment it is more likely to be retained unless sales clearly disappoint.

The modern incense smoker figurine is close to the core offer but tests contemporary design, so with low apparent downside and remaining demand uncertainty the firm would likely keep it as an option for another season.
